tools.name: check_date
tools.description: Tell whether a date is a Japanese national holiday, a weekend, or a business day, with the holiday name (Japanese and English) and the wareki date.

tools.name: list_holidays
tools.description: List Japanese national holidays (including substitute holidays) between two dates, up to 5 years.

tools.name: add_business_days
tools.description: Move forward (or backward with a negative number) by N business days in Japan, skipping weekends and national holidays. Use for due dates such as "within 5 business days".

tools.name: count_business_days
tools.description: Count business days in Japan between two dates (both ends included unless include_start is false).

tools.name: to_wareki
tools.description: Convert a Gregorian date to a Japanese era date (wareki), e.g. 2019-05-01 -> 令和元年5月1日 (R1.5.1). Supports dates from 1873-01-01.

tools.name: from_wareki
tools.description: Convert a Japanese era date to a Gregorian date. Accepts 令和8年11月18日, 令和元年5月1日, 平成三十一年四月三十日, R8.11.18, H31/4/30, Reiwa 8.11.18. Rejects dates that did not exist in that era (e.g. 平成31年5月1日).
